prompt: Can readable version information in frozen ports state drive autonomous BEGIN? Fit causal small action decoder, no oracle/gating/private features at inference, no reset.
source_rule: Assisted ports/undirected/recorded512/fixed/warmup complete endpoints147456; actual inherited endpoint h and world at every free fork.

train.positions: all live tick/job positions, including WAIT/FINISH
train.features: Endpoint-frozen backbone replay over original public observations and actual-action receipts. Initial h is original CP131072 h; continuously replay all8 actors without resets. These features differ from original historical h under changing weights.
train.labels: original midpoint teacher action; collapse1->BEGIN1,2->BEGIN2,everything else->OTHER
train.weights: original eleven-class weights before collapse: teacher WAIT0=.1, every nonWAIT=1; normalize weighted CE by sum of original row weights
train.fitting: separate seed/job affine reference-class softmax, OTHER logit fixed0; train-only population mean/std; zero-variance columns fixed0; squared L2=.001 on standardized slopes only
train.initialization: all decoder coefficients/bias zero; deterministic; no validation or hyperparameter search

policy: For each job, m=max(native WAIT and8 FINISH logits). Replace only BEGINk with m + decoder_logit(BEGINk)-decoder_logit(OTHER). Leave WAIT/FINISH logits unchanged. Eleven-way argmax. Inference features only public current obs or post-step h; no world/scorer labels.

test.scope: full8-actor worlds retained; actors4..7 held out from decoder fitting only (all8 were seen by original backbone training); report0..3 as decoder-training-lane overlap; future request identity sets disjoint from decoder training required
test.baseline: rerun unchanged native evaluator with read-only scorer shadow; entire result must exactly equal saved original endpoint evaluation
test.frozen: same actual endpoint model/world/h; no model learning, resets, cue suppression, state substitution, forced target action or oracle gate

metrics.primary: Decoder-fitting-heldout matured primary requests with accepted autonomous BEGIN / matured primary requests, plus feasible-correct accepted BEGIN subset; strict and ordinary completion on same primary request identities
metrics.timing: all-position teacher-BEGIN sensitivity and begin precision, wrong-version begins, duplicate begins; conditional diagnostic only
metrics.idle: inactive enabled job opportunities and false BEGIN per1000; all inactive actions separately
metrics.loop: own-trajectory shadow midpoint FINISH label positions, legal finish opportunities, FINISH attempts, legally timed attempts, accepted FINISH and matured completions
metrics.case_matching: same primary matured request fingerprints between all four policies; no counterfactual oracle trajectories
metrics.aggregation: sum four family counts within each seed/condition/group; three independent seeds, descriptive seed SD only

limitations: Externally supervised affine action controller; no claim native ports learned routing.
All80 and public_obs56 have greater feature dimension and parameter count than non_input24.
Replay training receipts arose under original changing-backbone assisted policy; autonomous evaluation distribution may differ.
No FINISH decoder is trained; OTHER class includes FINISH and native FINISH scores remain available.
